map.储罐容量与液位换算 使用指南: Tank Capacity and Level Conversion User Guide
map.储罐容量与液位换算工具按立式或卧式罐几何尺寸求总容量与给定液位下的体积，适合石化: The tank capacity and level tool computes total capacity and the volume at a given level from the geometry of a vertical or horizontal tank, fitting petrochemical storage, stocktaking, and receipt/shipment metering.
map.卧式罐液位体积 = L × [D²/4 × arccos(2h/D - 1) −: Horizontal tank level volume = L × [D²/4 × arccos(2h/D − 1) − (D/2 − h)×√(Dh − h²)]
map.油品库存盘点：立式拱顶罐按圆柱体积算总容量，按当前液位高度算存油量(吨)；工具输: Oil stocktaking: for a vertical domed tank the total capacity uses the cylinder volume and the stored oil (in tonnes) comes from the current level; the tool returns total capacity, safe capacity, and current volume to support stocktaking and dispatch.
map.卧式储罐液位计量：卧式罐液面为弓形截面，不能用圆柱公式直算；工具按弓形面积×罐长: Horizontal tank level metering: the liquid surface of a horizontal tank is a circular segment, so the cylinder formula cannot be applied directly; the tool uses segment area × tank length to get liquid volume, solving level ↔ volume conversion for tankers and horizontal buffer tanks.
map.安全充装校核：设安全充装率(如 90%)后，当前液位超过安全上限会告警，避免热膨: Safe fill check: once a safe fill rate (such as 90%) is set, exceeding the safe upper level raises an alarm, preventing thermal expansion or tank overflow and meeting safe tank operating procedures.
map.算例：立式与卧式各一例: Worked examples: one vertical tank and one horizontal tank
map.：立式罐 D=4m、L=10m、液位 8m、密度 850、安全 90%：总容量=:
: vertical tank D = 4 m, L = 10 m, level 8 m, density 850, safety 90%: total capacity = π×(2)²×10 = 125.66 m³; safe capacity = 125.66×90% = 113.10 m³; liquid volume = π×(2)²×8 = 100.53 m³; mass = 100.53×850/1000 = 85.45 t; fill rate = 100.53/125.66 = 80.0%.
Horizontal tank D = 3 m, L = 8 m, level 1.5 m (the radius, half full), density 750: total capacity = π×(1.5)²×8 = 56.55 m³; segment area = 1.5²×acos(0) − 0 = 3.534 m²; liquid volume = 3.534×8 = 28.27 m³; mass = 28.27×750/1000 = 21.21 t; fill rate = 50.0%.
map.立式和卧式储罐算法有何不同？: How Do the Vertical and Horizontal Tank Algorithms Differ?
map.立式罐液面为矩形截面，液体体积=π×r²×液位高；卧式罐液面是圆截面上的弓形，需: A vertical tank has a rectangular cross-section, so liquid volume = π×r²×level; a horizontal tank has a circular-segment surface, so use the segment area formula area = r²·acos((r−h)/r) − (r−h)·√(2rh−h²) and multiply by the tank length — at half full (h = r) it is exactly half the tank.
map.安全液位/安全容量怎么用？: How Do I Use the Safe Level and Safe Capacity?
map.安全容量=总容量×安全充装率(%)；当当前液量超过安全容量会提示「超出安全液位」: Safe capacity = total capacity × safe fill rate (%); when the current liquid volume exceeds the safe capacity the tool warns that the safe level is exceeded. The setting reserves room for thermal expansion and vapor space to prevent overflow, and the exact limit depends on the tank type and medium.
